greeting.title: Greeting
paragraphs: EV Laser took its first step in April 2002 as EuroVision, a venture founded to develop industrial laser application technologies. For a quarter of a century since, we have walked a single path — laser technology — delivering innovative laser solutions across automotive, electronics, semiconductors, secondary batteries, petrochemicals, ICT, machinery, medical-bio & healthcare, heavy industry, steel, shipbuilding and aerospace — virtually every industry. Along the way, we have grown together with countless partners across Europe, the Americas, China, Japan and Southeast Asia, building lasting trust.

In 2018 we adopted our new name, EVLASER CO., LTD., and in 2022 we established a local subsidiary in Suzhou, China — preparing a greater leap forward as a global company that reaches beyond Korea to the world.

Our corporate R&D institute, staffed by specialists holding master's and doctoral degrees, together with our Laser Technology Center equipped with more than 20 types of laser processing and R&D facilities, firmly strengthens our standing as a laser specialist and serves as a solid springboard to the global market. The strong partnerships we have built over many years with leading laser companies and institutions abroad have been a driving force behind our growth and successful global expansion.

As a specialist in laser application technology, we are recognized for our expertise and technical capability across virtually every field where lasers are used — laser welding (metal, plastic, glass), cutting (metal, plastic, glass, paper, wood, fabric), marking, soldering, cleaning, heat treatment, cladding, precision machining, and laser safety consulting.

Rather than settling for the present, every member of EV Laser embraces a single goal — “Better laser technology shapes a better world” — and prepares for tomorrow with unwavering dedication. We may not be a flashy company, but we will strive to be one where our people and their families are happy, our customers are satisfied, and we give back to our community and country — a company where everyone grows and thrives together.

history.title: History
history.summary: EVLASER CO., LTD. specializes in the development of laser processes and the development and supply of laser systems. Since our founding in 2002, we have grown Win-Win partnerships with roughly 350 customers in Korea and abroad by developing and delivering technology aligned with market needs and trends.

Received Venture Company Citation (Small and Medium Business Administration)

Received Excellent Capital Goods Development Citation (Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy)
Certified as a Root Technology Specialist Company (Small and Medium Business Administration)
Renamed to EVLASER CO., LTD. / EVLaser Co., Ltd.

Secured 3D scanner laser plastic welding technology
Relocated ELTC (Laser Technology Center) to an expanded new plant

Won the OFweek Cup · OFweek 2024 Laser Industry Annual Award (China)
